question: Where can I get the official zoning that classifies land for renewable energy siting in Spain, such as environmental sensitivity maps or renewables acceleration areas, as geometry, with category and the technologies it applies to?

answer.summary: Spain has no national vector zoning and no designated renewables acceleration areas (ZAR). MITECO's national sensitivity model for wind and PV (5 classes) is a 25 m raster (GeoTIFF, WMS, WCS). ZAR are designated by regions (RDL 7/2026; decree pending); only Canarias publishes them (La Gomera, El Hierro, WMS). Vector zoning exists in Asturias, Baleares, Castilla y Leon, Navarra, Euskadi, Valencia; Madrid is raster.
main_caveats: The national ISA is a 25 m raster: values are pixel values (0-10000 or classes 0-4); there are no polygons or attributes unless you vectorise it yourself.
MITECO calls the model orientative; it does not designate suitable zones. Class 0 means 'Maxima (no recomendado)'.
Canarias ZAR are proposals under island protocols (La Gomera 2025-07-30, El Hierro 2026-05-19); the WMS forbids commercial use and bulk download; Lanzarote is not in it.
Regional layers differ in age and legal meaning (Baleares 2014 plan, Asturias 2008 directives, Navarra 2019, Euskadi 2021, CyL DL 2/2022 exclusions) and are not comparable.
The WMS addresses in the 2021 MITECO access PDF (wmts.mapama.gob.es) return 404; use gis.miteco.gob.es/geoserver/evaluacionambiental.
answer.confidence_reason: All 19 regions and cities were checked; 8 have data I queried or downloaded, 7 returned nothing after opened pages, and 3 maps could not be reached by my client.

attributes.note: National model is raster. Vector polygons via WFS/REST/shapefile in 6 regions; Canarias ZAR only as WMS images; Madrid raster.
attributes.gap_note: No national vector found: MITECO offers GeoTIFF, WMS, WCS only; Anexo VI says no region had downloadable PV vector in 2020.

attributes.note: ISA classes Maxima to Baja; ZAR apta/condicionada; Baleares, Navarra, Asturias, Euskadi each with own classes.
Wind and PV separate nationally; Canarias eolica/FV/mixta; Navarra and Asturias wind only; Valencia and Madrid PV only.

how_to_use.example_result: {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","id":"","geometry":null,"properties":{"GRAY_INDEX":2}}]} (class 2 = Alta). Same point in ea_energia_eolica returned GRAY_INDEX 6510 (ISA). Local file: gdallocationinfo -wgs84 -valonly Clas_ISA_eol_pb.tiff -5.45 37.55 returned 2.
steps: Download the zip from the landing page (wind: Zonificacion_EOL_clasificada_2024.zip, 38.5 MB; PV: Zonificacion_FTV_clasificada_2024.zip, 46 MB); each holds a _pb GeoTIFF (Peninsula+Baleares), a _c GeoTIFF (Canarias) and 'leeme_valores ISA.pdf'.
Read value 0-4 per pixel with GDAL; map 0 Maxima, 1 Muy alta, 2 Alta, 3 Moderada, 4 Baja. Use Modelo_ISA_* zips for the 0-10000 index.
Technology is the layer: eolica and fotovoltaica are separate files and services (ea_clasificacion_energia_eolica / _fotovoltaica; ea_energia_eolica / _fotovoltaica).

For a small area use WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage (coverageId evaluacionambiental__ea_clasificacion_energia_eolica, subset E and N in EPSG:25830), which returned a GeoTIFF; to get polygons, vectorise yourself (gdal_polygonize) and say so.
reading_traps: Raster, not geometry: there are no polygon features or attributes; WMS GetFeatureInfo returns only a pixel value and geometry null.
Scale is inverted: low ISA means high sensitivity; value 0 is the maximum sensitivity class, not 'no data'. NoData is 65535 (sea and outside Spain).
Two CRS in one zip: _pb is EPSG:25830, _c (Canarias) is EPSG:32628.
A Madrid city centre point returned class 0 in the wind file; urban cores are exclusion indicators.
The access PDF (2021) lists wmts.mapama.gob.es WMS URLs that return 404 now; the working service is gis.miteco.gob.es/geoserver/evaluacionambiental.
Regional laws point to it: RDL 7/2026 art. 15.1.f excludes its 'zonas de mayor sensibilidad' from ZAR; Castilla-La Mancha Ley 7/2022 fast-tracks projects in 'sensibilidad baja'.

problems: WMS URLs in the official 2021 access PDF (wmts.mapama.gob.es/sig/evaluacionambiental/.../wms) return HTTP 404.
The page offers GeoTIFF only; no shapefile or vector was found despite some secondary texts mentioning shapefiles.

Use GetFeatureInfo with info_format application/vnd.ogc.gml (JSON is rejected) to read category attributes at a point.

reading_traps: WMS only: polygons are not downloadable; GetFeatureInfo gives a bbox in the GML but no full geometry.
Features are proposals under island protocols, not final designation plans under RDL 7/2026 art. 16.

Lanzarote and La Graciosa are not in this WMS (tested with GetMap); press says their map is in the GRAFCAN viewer and that its publication is disputed.

steps: CyL: list layers with the WFS GetCapabilities; use typeNames energia:energia_cyl_renov_zonas_excl_instal_eoli or _foto; resultType=hits for counts; outputFormat application/json, shape-zip or gpkg.
Baleares: query .../MapServer/0 (PV) or /1 (wind) with where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson; decode LV_REST with the layer legend.
Navarra: WFS typeNames BIODIV_Pol_AcogidaEoli; default page is 1000 features, so page with startIndex and count, or cql_filter=CZONA=n.
Asturias: .../Visor_RPGUR/MapServer/10/query with f=geojson; ZONA and TIPO give the category.
Euskadi: download the 819 MB zip (Range requests work) and open Eolica_A_2021_10000.shp or Fotov_A_2021_10000.shp; filter by SENSIBILID.
Valencia: WFS typename list in GetCapabilities (20 layers incl. flood layers); the PV criteria are Cauces.*, RecargaAcuiferos, Paisajistico.*; outputformat gpkg works, gml3 default.
La Rioja: blocked to automated clients (HTTP 403 Cloudflare); use the datos.gob.es record to find the human download page.
reading_traps: Classes are not comparable across regions (exclusion vs aptitude vs capacity vs sensitivity).
Navarra and Asturias are wind only; Valencia is PV only; Euskadi has both as separate shapefiles.
Baleares layers date from the 2014 Plan Director although the feed is refreshed monthly; LV_REST meaning comes from the legend order, not a coded field.
Euskadi wind shapefile has 880,112 tiny polygons (about 701 MB of .shp uncompressed) because it is a vectorised grid: dissolve by SENSIBILID before using.
WFS default page size: Navarra returned 1000 of 26,763 features without paging; Valencia WFS default output is GML, not JSON.

problems: La Rioja download and catalogue return HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to automated clients.
Euskadi zip is 819 MB, read by Range only.

inclusion_rule.value: Madrid index combines environmental and territorial factors, some of maximum sensitivity or exclusion and others weighted.
inclusion_rule.quote: Dicho índice se ha calculado teniendo en cuenta diversos factores ambientales y territoriales, algunos de los de máxima sensibilidad o de exclusión, y otros de ponderación.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o ftv.zip https://idem.comunidad.madrid/recursos_cat_geo/Catalogo/recursos/RecursosEnergeticos/Indice_Capacidad_Acogida_FTV.zip && unzip ftv.zip && gdallocationinfo -wgs84 -valonly Indice_Capacidad_Acogida_FTV.tif -3.5 40.6

steps: Madrid: download the zip, read the GeoTIFF with GDAL, EPSG:25830, 25 m.
Extremadura: pdftotext the DOE resolution for the category text; the map is an image in Anexo I.
Cataluna: the annex zip is 5.18 GB and supports Range requests; its index lists about 970 PDF sheets; it is a draft in public information.
reading_traps: Madrid is a continuous index, not classes; no thresholds are published in the files opened.
Extremadura priority map is an image: no geometry; PV only.
Cataluna PLATER is a preliminary draft (public information from May 2026, approval foreseen 2027 per press); do not treat as in force.

problems: Murcia IDERM hosts do not resolve from the tool used.

evidence.quote: Capa ráster con un tamaño de píxel de 25 x 25 m en el que se representa el valor de un índice representativo de la capacidad del territorio de la Comunidad de Madrid para acoger instalaciones fotovoltaicas (paneles solares).

Son consideradas como zonas prioritarias para el desarrollo de proyectos de energía solar fotovoltaica las incluidas en las categorías de “Alta” y “Muy Alta Capacidad de Acogida” que aparecen identificadas en el plano anexo a la presente resolución.
El documento que aparece en información pública es la versión preliminar del Plater

regulator.name: MITECO - Subdireccion General de Evaluacion Ambiental (national model); regional governments designate ZAR

operators.note: No operators: zoning is produced by the State (ISA) and by 17 regions and 2 autonomous cities (ZAR, regional plans). No census of zoning publishers found.

publication_obligation.norm: Real Decreto-ley 7/2026, de 20 de marzo, art. 16.11
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Regions must send resolutions and georeferenced digital cartography of designated ZAR to MITECO for publication.
publication_obligation.frequency: Not set; depends on a royal decree not yet approved.

consolidated_republication.note: Art. 16.11 RDL 7/2026 foresees MITECO publishing regional ZAR cartography; no such publication was found in November 2026.

checked_pages.saw: National ISA GeoTIFF and WMS only; no regional zoning or ZAR layer republished.
Anexo VI: regional zoning was reviewed but not integrated because criteria differ; table of which regions had downloadable cartography (2020).
IDE service directory lists ea_energia_eolica, ea_energia_fotovoltaica and their classified layers; no ZAR or regional zoning service.
Prior consultation for the ZAR royal decree (closed); no state map of ZAR.

national_registry.note: A national official layer exists for environmental sensitivity (ISA, raster) but no national register of designated renewable siting zones or ZAR; regions publish their own zoning.

checked_pages.saw: Two layers (wind, PV) of sensitivity index; GeoTIFF downloads.
RDL 7/2026 arts. 14-18: ZAR framework; regions designate; no map in the text.
Lists ZAR protocols for La Gomera, El Hierro, Lanzarote and La Graciosa.
National open data portal; only the offshore wind zoning found as a related dataset.

recipe: For national classes, do not parse documents: use the GeoTIFFs or WMS (source 1).
For ZAR, watch the official bulletin of each region and the MITECO page; art. 16.11 RDL 7/2026 says regions send georeferenced cartography to MITECO for publication.
In DOE or BOE PDFs run pdftotext to read the category text (done on the Extremadura DOE resolution and the Belchite DIA); map annexes are images and give no coordinates.
Do not infer zone geometry from project DIAs: they give a class per site only.
if_unstructured.location_method: Documents tested give no coordinates for zones (DOE annex is an image plan). Digital capacity maps for Extremadura are said to be on the extremambiente web, not reached; Cataluna sheets are PDF maps.
cross_with: MITECO ISA GeoTIFF (source 1) to compare with regional classes
RDL 7/2026 art. 15 exclusion list (Red Natura 2000, protected areas, critical areas) with the protected-areas files
Canarias ZAR protocols PDF per island

where_published.name: BOE: Real Decreto-ley 7/2026 (ZAR framework)
where_published.what: Legal framework for ZAR: who designates, exclusions, effects; no map.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE buscar (boe.es/buscar) with text search in 'Disposiciones'; search 'Zonas de Aceleracion Renovable'; regions will publish designation plans in their own official bulletins.

example_document.what_it_gives: Art. 15.1: 'En ningún caso se podrán incluir en las ZAR las áreas protegidas declaradas bajo alguna de las siguientes figuras: a) Zonas Red Natura 2000, ZEPA y ZEC.' (p. 52). Art. 16.1: 'La designación de ZAR se realizará por las autoridades competentes de las comunidades y ciudades autónomas mediante la aprobación de un plan de designación de ZAR' (p. 53).

where_published.name: BOE: declaraciones de impacto ambiental of MITECO that cite the ISA
where_published.what: Project-level DIA resolutions that state whether the site falls in an ISA sensitivity class.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: BOE advanced search, section III, MITECO, text 'declaracion de impacto ambiental' plus 'sensibilidad ambiental'; results are per project, no zoning geometry.

example_document.what_it_gives: DIA of the Belchite PV hybrid plant (13.5 MW), p. 138330 onwards: 'se localiza en un área de sensibilidad ambiental máxima, según la herramienta de zonificación ambiental para energías renovables desarrollada por el Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico'.

where_published.name: DOE Extremadura: resolucion de zonas prioritarias fotovoltaica
where_published.what: Priority PV map published as an annexed plan (image) in the regional gazette.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Junta de Extremadura news page and DOE search by date (2026-02-19, num. 34); the plan is Anexo I.

example_document.what_it_gives: 'Segundo. Son consideradas como zonas prioritarias para el desarrollo de proyectos de energía solar fotovoltaica las incluidas en las categorías de “Alta” y “Muy Alta Capacidad de Acogida” que aparecen identificadas en el plano anexo a la presente resolución.' (DOE p. 8118); Anexo I is a map image, not text.

where_published.how_to_search_inside: Page lists annex zips and memoria PDFs; the participa.gencat.cat consultation holds the viewer for municipalities (not opened).

example_document.what_it_gives: Zip of 5.18 GB; its index lists about 970 PDF sheets named like '20260226. Full 10-10.pdf' (Range read of the zip directory); contents of the sheets not opened.

open_questions: Canarias: a Nov 2025 article says the ZAR of Lanzarote and La Gomera were approved while May 2026 reports a Lanzarote map error and renegotiation; I could not settle the legal status of each island's ZAR.
Baleares licence: CKAN states CC-BY while the IDEIB metadata states Creative Commons by-sa; only the publisher can say which applies.
Whether MITECO will publish regional ZAR cartography under art. 16.11 RDL 7/2026 and where, since the implementing royal decree was still only at prior consultation in the pages opened.

Lanzarote and La Graciosa ZAR maps are reported in the GRAFCAN portal but are not in the IDECanarias ZAR WMS and press says their publication is disputed; which service, if any, serves them cannot be settled from the pages opened.

history.note: National ISA is raster; no ZAR designated nationally; Canarias ZAR via WMS; vector zoning in Asturias, Baleares, CyL, Navarra, Euskadi, Valencia; all 19 regions checked.
